description: P30: formations proven on a walled 440 x 160 m floor - a pike regiment (x -190) and a shield wall (x -155) in the west, a pike line 10 m south of a 6 m gate in a wall with flee points beyond it in the middle, and the 40-member stress case in the east (x 160): no two clusters within 150 m, so each fits the formation caps. Its encounters wait for test.formation.manual (never set): tests and the stress scenario activate them.
